settings.story_line: Stop treating hair from the outside. Start feeding it from within.

settings.title: Food-based nutrition
settings.text: Faster absorption than capsules. Whole seeds and herbs — no synthetic vitamin stack.

settings.title: Ayurvedic intelligence
settings.text: Amla, Bhringraj, Ashwagandha, Shatavari and more — chosen for hair and vitality roles.

settings.title: Built for 90 days
settings.text: One morning ritual aligned with the hair growth cycle. Consistency over miracles.

settings.title: Scoop one serving
settings.text: Take one serving of Kesha Mula every morning.

settings.title: Mix & drink
settings.text: Mix with water, buttermilk or juice. Drink on an empty stomach.

settings.title: Massage with Amrith
settings.text: For the Combo: warm a few drops of Kesha Amrith and massage into the scalp 2–3 times a week.

settings.title: Stay consistent
settings.text: Continue for 90 days. Hair transformation is a cycle, not a weekend.

settings.title: Foundation
settings.text: Ritual builds. Many notice less shed in the shower.

settings.title: Strength
settings.text: Roots feel better supported. Texture often improves.

settings.title: Transformation
settings.text: A full growth cycle of inside-out care.

settings.question: How long until I notice a difference?
settings.answer: Hair grows on roughly a 90-day cycle. Many notice reduced shedding earlier. Individual results vary.

settings.question: Any side effects?
settings.answer: Formulated from food-based ingredients. Reduce or stop if discomfort occurs and consult a professional if needed.

settings.question: How should I store it?
settings.answer: Keep sealed in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.
